title: Martin Short Is Mr. Emmy! (And He Has the Home Movies to Prove It)
summary:
Have you ever watched a funny show and wondered who makes you laugh? Well, Martin Short is a very funny guy, and this year he's everywhere! He's nominated for not one, not two, but three different Emmy Awards. That's like getting three golden tickets to the best TV party ever.

First, he's nominated for acting in the funny mystery show 'Only Murders in the Building.' He also helps make that show, so he got another nomination for that. Second, he hosts a game show called 'Match Game,' and he's nominated for that too. Third, there's a documentary about his life called 'Marty, Life Is Short.' That movie got three nominations as well!

Martin Short is Canadian, and he says Canadians are a little reserved (that means shy). So when a director named Lawrence Kasdan wanted to make a movie about him, Martin wasn't sure. But then Kasdan left a super long message—eight minutes!—explaining why Martin's story was important. Martin also had a treasure chest of home movies. He filmed his kids with a camcorder (a small video camera) for years. He even had shelves of these movies! He gave them to Kasdan to use in the documentary. And guess what? Steven Spielberg, the famous movie director, also sent over home movies he had with Martin in them. Cool, right?

Martin has had some sad times too. His daughter passed away, and it was really hard. But he decided to go ahead with the documentary because he wants to show that humor can help you through tough times. He says, 'I am Mr. Emmy this year!' And he's not wrong. Go, Martin!
why_it_matters: It can remind kids that even funny people have hard days, and humor can help families and friends get through sad or stressful times.
